{{Spell InfoBox|image=Arcane_Barrier.png|type=Spell Passive|rarity=Epic|misc_a_1=Occupied Slots: 3|misc_b_1=Max MP of the wand +120|misc_c_1=Arcane Barrier consumes 1 point of damage with 3% of Max MP and inflicts 4 times the MP cost on targets within a radius of 4m}}'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an [[Rarity|Epic]] [[Spells|Spell]] of [[Spell Types|Type]]: Spell Passive. Damage to the player gets redirected to the Mana of the wand.

'''Description:''' The barrier is only created when the wand is fully charged with MP, and disappears when the wand runs out of MP.

Multiple wands equip the passive skill Arcane barrier simultaneously, and the share the MP and the effect.
